name: signup-offer
about: Before an account exists: whether the node takes sign-ups (closed in test mode unless with an invite), the starter limits and the first-month offer (free days, the fair-use allowance in dollars, sandboxes before a card, the refundable card check).

response.closedReason: Sign-up is closed: this node runs in test mode and takes no real customers yet. If an operator sent you a sign-up invite, enter its code.

offer.expect: The $1.00 card check is refunded at once. Nothing is charged in your free month (30 days, up to $80 of use). After that, your card is charged $20 each time your balance falls below $5; you can change the amounts or turn this off.
